hypothesis: A generated native-meta implementation_ref can be parsed and compiled without current outcome access into a typed deterministic meta-policy program that changes future candidate-generation behavior in the policy's intended family.
falsifier: FAIL if FULL does not change the precommitted future-generation probe relative to parent behavior, if REMOVE/no resolver reproduces the FULL change, if WRONG family or SHUFFLE/ref swap is accepted as the intended policy, if malformed or provenance-inconsistent refs fail open, if current outcomes are consumed, or if restart compilation of the same ref produces a different policy fingerprint/behavior.
full_control: Compile the frozen generated native-meta generator and mutator refs and execute each on fresh precommitted residual probes.
remove_control: Use the identical descendant morphology with native-meta resolver removed/disabled; behavior must revert to parent/no-policy behavior.
wrong_control: Bind a generator ref to a mutator target and vice versa; fail closed or produce no authorized intended-family effect.
shuffle_control: Swap independently generated refs across residual identities; provenance/residual binding must reject the intended effect.
restart_control: Cold compile the same implementation_ref twice; policy fingerprint and probe behavior must be identical.
